freezeHow: Missed a day? The freeze kicks in on its own, for up to {until}.
A snowball replaces your flame on those days; your streak doesn't break.
Days it didn't use are kept for next time.

puzzle_streak_pass.label: Puzzle Streak pass
how: Stumped? Before playing, use the pass: the solution appears.
You move on to an equivalent puzzle, same theme, same level.

puzzle_streak_help.label: Puzzle Streak help
how: The piece to move lights up.
You find the move: the streak continues as normal.

puzzle_pardon.label: Mistake pardoned · Puzzles
how: On the failure sheet, tap “Pardon”: no points lost.
The puzzle stays missed, your rating goes back to what it was.

blindfold_pardon.label: Mistake pardoned · Blindfold
how: You play a wrong move, or miss the puzzle, with your eyes closed.
Tap “Pardon”: your mistakes are erased, your peek comes back.
The puzzle counts as solved, with all its XP.

coordinates_pardon.label: Mistake pardoned · Coordinates
how: Turn on “Pardon” when starting your series.
Your first wrong square doesn't count.
No mistake: your pardon stays in stock.
